selection_rule: Highest R-squared on the held-out test set.

metric_explanations.MAE: Lower is better — average absolute ₹ error on the test set.
metric_explanations.MSE: Lower is better — mean of squared ₹ errors (penalises large misses).
metric_explanations.RMSE: Lower is better — square root of MSE, in ₹.
metric_explanations.R2: Higher is better — proportion of price variance explained (max 1.0).
